name: cx-box-carry
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) is the reach-the-exit goal. Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires the box in hand on arrival, which is what carrying it to the exit means. Response(box_fell, holding_box) is the whenever-the-box-falls re-pickup and is satisfiable, because the agent faces a fallen box and can pick it up on the next step. All three are hard, each traces to the task wording, and none adds a requirement the task does not state.

texts: Be carrying the box when reaching the exit.
Whenever the box falls, pick it up again.
machine:

INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0

(u0, at_exit&!box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&!holding_box) -> u4
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u1, !at_exit&holding_box) -> u0
(u1, at_exit&!holding_box) -> u4
(u1, at_exit&holding_box) -> u3
(u2, !box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u2, box_fell&!holding_box) -> u4
(u2, box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u4, holding_box) -> u3
